recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Any future cleanup of historical translation entries or creation of new tooling-specific profiles should be handled as separate maintenance/work-group work, not as required application of FHIR-15708.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-I STU3 request to collapse ImplementationGuideInput and ImplementationGuideOutput back into ImplementationGuide, with definition content for publisher input and manifest content generated by publication tooling.
initial_application: No explicit FHIR-15708 commit was found. The apparent application is b319b6a0dac9ca63360026abf48be963f7b143b9, which removed ImplementationGuideInput and ImplementationGuideOutput from active fhir.ini mappings, placed them under removed resources, and reworked ImplementationGuide source content around definition and manifest.
additional_context: Current fhir.ini keeps ImplementationGuide active and the former split resources only in [removed-resources]. The current StructureDefinition describes ImplementationGuide.definition as information needed by an IG publisher tool and ImplementationGuide.manifest as assembled implementation guide information created by publication tooling; the example includes both. Zulip IG Tooling SIG discussion shows the input/output split was exploratory and might be squashed back together. Later IG issues such as FHIR-24826 are adjacent but do not reverse this decision.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current core source already implements the approved collapse and no active build-scope source fix is needed.
